properties.name: A consumer-facing fact about the served surface — what a person types, reads, or may use — is served by reflow2, never copied by a consumer; the choice of what to show stays the consumer's
properties.statement: flo2, 2026-09-18, three instances in one day: the restricted tool subset for an external endpoint, the roster of third-party MCPs, the skill menu — each time the cheap local answer was a hand-maintained copy of a moving upstream surface and the durable answer a small field served upstream. The rule: the FIELD is upstream (shortcut, summary, audience, read-only marking, the differing count) and the CHOICE stays downstream (which subset, to whom). A count the surface states about itself is computed, never written. Delivered where a consumer reads the surface to present it.
